test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Uncanny
solution:
The solution is **Ordinary. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM for "**Uncanny**" is Ordinary.
 
• Uncanny - Strange or mysterious.
 
 
• ​*For example: "An uncanny feeling that I was being watched."*
 
 
 
• *​*Ordinary - With no special or distinctive features.
 
 
• ​​*For example: "It was just an ordinary day today."*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *Antonyms:*

 
 
• Antonyms is the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
 
• For example :- Antonym of *good is bad, little is more.*
 
 
 
• *​*Antonym of **Queer **is normal.
 
• Antonym of **Unduly **is **duly**.
 
• Antonym of **Saintly **is unholy.
